caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, front view of a woman with short dark hair and blue eyes, wearing a dress with a fitted bodice and puffed short sleeves. The dress is patterned with vertical green stripes alternating with white stripes covered in brown dots. The neckline and sleeve edges are trimmed with green. The woman's visible arms are shaded brown, and her hands rest along the sides of her skirt. She is wearing brown shoes over white stockings. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, monochrome sketch showing the back view of the same dress design, as well as a separate outlined drawing of a shoe, positioned to the lower right of the back view sketch. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Doll
